title: Melanoma Immunotherapy Preprocessing Data Dictionary
description: Comprehensive data dictionary for harmonised clinical, genomic, transcriptomic, and treatment features across melanoma cohorts.

RESPONSE.harmonised_definition: Response evaluation criteria in solid tumours (RECIST 1.1) category.

van_allen_2015.notes: Mapped from abbreviation codes (CR, PR, SD, PD).

skcm_tcga_gdc.notes: Extracted from GDC treatment timeline data (immunotherapy priority).

skcm_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018.notes: Extracted from PanCan treatment timeline data.

RESPONSE_BINARY.harmonised_definition: Binary response classification (1 = Responder, 0 = Non-Responder, NaN = Stable Disease/Unmapped).

OS_MONTHS.harmonised_definition: Duration from diagnosis/treatment to last follow-up or death in months.

OS_STATUS.harmonised_definition: Binary vital status indicator at last follow-up.

PFS_MONTHS.harmonised_definition: Time from baseline to progression or death.

AGE.harmonised_definition: Age at diagnosis or study entry.

SPECIMEN_TYPE.harmonised_definition: Anatomic origin of sequenced tumor specimen.

IMMUNOTHERAPY.harmonised_definition: Binary indicator of prior or current immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.

TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS.harmonised_definition: Count of non-silent somatic mutations in protein-coding regions.

skcm_tcga_gdc.notes: Filtered from GDC MAF for non-silent variant classifications.

SNV_NEOANTIGEN.harmonised_definition: Predicted single nucleotide variant neoepitope burden.

mut_BRAF.harmonised_definition: Binary indicator of non-silent mutation in BRAF gene.

mut_NRAS.harmonised_definition: Binary indicator of non-silent mutation in NRAS gene.

mut_NF1.harmonised_definition: Binary indicator of non-silent mutation in NF1 gene.

WINTER_HYPOXIA_SCORE.harmonised_definition: Gene expression-derived tumor hypoxia signature score (Winter et al.).

TREATMENT_OUTCOME.harmonised_definition: Best overall therapeutic outcome extracted from clinical timeline data.

TX_IMMUNOTHERAPY_OUTCOME.harmonised_definition: Specific outcome recorded for immunotherapy treatment events.

ARI vs K-Means.harmonised_definition: Clinical metadata attribute ARI vs K-Means.

NEW_TUMOR_EVENT_AFTER_INITIAL_TREATMENT.display_name: New Tumor Event After Initial Treatment

Response Rate Spread (%).harmonised_definition: Clinical metadata attribute Response Rate Spread (%).

TX_AGENT_INTERFERON.harmonised_definition: Binary indicator of treatment administration of agent Interferon.

TX_AGENT_VEMURAFENIB.harmonised_definition: Binary indicator of treatment administration of agent Vemurafenib.
